## Runtime convention

All course commands use one mounted working directory:

```bash
docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD":/work -w /work IMAGE bash
podman run --rm -it -v "$PWD":/work -w /work IMAGE bash
```

## Why this matters

The container provides software. The mounted project folder provides persistent files. This separation makes the analysis portable across macOS, Linux, and Windows WSL2.

## Practical limits

Use two threads by default:

```bash
THREADS=2
```

More threads can overload student laptops and make failures harder to debug.
